themes.name: Light
themes.description: Official theme used by apps/chat-web. Mirrors src/index.css 1:1.

themes.name: Dark
themes.description: Parity with the .dark block declared in src/index.css. Production app does not use it yet; provided as a DS contract for a future dark mode rollout.

themes.name: Brand Blue
themes.description: Forked brand palette (royal blue instead of cyan). Demonstrates how to ship a new theme without touching foundations.

themes.name: Auto (system)
themes.description: Mirrors prefers-color-scheme: dark. Use to give the user a system-mode toggle without committing to a manual switcher.
